topic_title: Alternate Forms of the Pythagorean Identity
legacy_markdown:
$$
\begin{aligned}
3\cos^{2} x\sec^{2} x - 3\cos^{2} x &= 3\cos^{2} x \cdot (\frac{1}{\cos x})^{2} - 3\cos^{2} x \\
&= 3\cos^{2} x \cdot \frac{1}{\cos^{2} x} - 3\cos^{2} x \\
&= \frac{3\cos^{2} x}{\cos^{2} x} - 3\cos^{2} x \\
&= \frac{3\cos^{2} x}{\cos^{2} x} - 3\cos^{2} x \\
&= 3 - 3\cos^{2} x \\
&= 3(1 - \cos^{2} x)
\end{aligned}
$$

6x \cdot (\frac{1 + x}{x}) + 6x \cdot (\frac{5 + x}{6x}) &= 2 \cdot 3x \cdot (\frac{1 - x}{3x}) \\
6(1 + x) + (5 + x) &= 2(1 - x)
\end{aligned}

24\sqrt{2} &= 3\sqrt{2}c \\
24 &= 3c \\

\end{aligned}

legacy_text: \sin θ ⋅ \csc^{2} θ|= \sin θ ⋅ (1)/(\sin^{2} θ); = \sin θ ⋅ (1)/(\sin θ ⋅ \sin θ); = (1)/(\sin θ); = \csc θ
legacy_markdown:
$$
\begin{aligned}
\sin θ \cdot \csc^{2} θ &= \sin θ \cdot \frac{1}{\sin^{2} θ} \\
&= \sin θ \cdot \frac{1}{\sin θ \cdot \sin θ} \\
&= \frac{1}{\sin θ} \\
&= \csc θ
\end{aligned}
$$

topic_title: Simplifying Trigonometric Expressions Using the Cotangent-Cosecant Identity
legacy_text: (1)/(\csc θ + \cot θ) + \cot θ|= (\csc^{2} θ − \cot^{2} θ)/(\csc θ + \cot θ) + \cot θ; = ((\csc θ − \cot θ)(\csc θ + \cot θ))/(\csc θ + \cot θ) + \cot θ; = ((\csc θ − \cot θ)(\csc θ + \cot θ))/(\csc θ + \cot θ) + \cot θ; = (\csc θ − \cot θ) + \cot θ; = \csc θ.
legacy_markdown:
$$
\begin{aligned}
\frac{1}{\csc θ + \cot θ} + \cot θ &= \frac{\csc^{2} θ - \cot^{2} θ}{\csc θ + \cot θ} + \cot θ \\
&= ((\csc θ - \cot θ)(\csc θ + \cot θ))/(\csc θ + \cot θ) + \cot θ \\
&= ((\csc θ - \cot θ)(\csc θ + \cot θ))/(\csc θ + \cot θ) + \cot θ \\
&= (\csc θ - \cot θ) + \cot θ \\
&= \csc θ
\end{aligned}
$$

&= ∼\begin{bmatrix}1 & 0 \\ -3 & -1\end{bmatrix} \\
&\ne I\cdot \\
B &= \begin{bmatrix}1 & 1 \\ 1 & 0\end{bmatrix}\begin{vmatrix}R_{1} & ↔R_{2} \\ ∼\begin{bmatrix}1 & 0 \\ 1 & 1\end{bmatrix} & R_{2}\end{vmatrix}:=R_{2} + (-1)R_{1} \\
&= ∼\begin{bmatrix}1 & 0 \\ 0 & 1\end{bmatrix} \\
&= I✓
\end{aligned}
$$

legacy_text: P(3 < X ≤ 5, 2 < Y ≤ 4)|= P(X ≤ 5, Y ≤ 4)^(⏞)^(top-right corner at [math](5,4)[/math]); = − P(X ≤ 5, Y ≤ 2)^(⏞)^(top-right corner at [math](5,2)[/math]) − P(X ≤ 3, Y ≤ 4)^(⏞)^(top-right corner at [math](3,4)[/math]); = + P(X ≤ 3, Y ≤ 2)^(⏞)^(top-right corner at [math](3,2)[/math]); = F(5, 4) − F(5, 2) − F(3, 4) + F(3, 2); = 0.9 − 0.2 − 0.5 + 0.1; = 0.3.
legacy_markdown:
$$
\begin{aligned}
P(3 < X \le 5, 2 < Y \le 4) &= P(X \le 5, Y \le 4)^(⏞)^(top-right corner at [math](5,4)[/math]) \\
&=-P(X \le 5, Y \le 2)^(⏞)^(top-right corner at [math](5,2)[/math]) - P(X \le 3, Y \le 4)^(⏞)^(top-right corner at [math](3,4)[/math]) \\
&= + P(X \le 3, Y \le 2)^(⏞)^(top-right corner at [math](3,2)[/math]) \\
&= F(5, 4) - F(5, 2) - F(3, 4) + F(3, 2) \\
&= 0.9 - 0.2 - 0.5 + 0.1 \\
&= 0.3
\end{aligned}
$$

legacy_markdown:
$$
\begin{aligned}
E\begin{bmatrix}Y & X = x\end{bmatrix} &= \int_{- ∞}^{∞}yf_{Y\mid X}(y \mid x)dy \\
&= \int_{0}^{x}y \cdot (2(x + y))/(3x^{2})dy \\
&= \frac{2}{3x^{2}}\int_{0}^{x}(xy + y^{2})dy \\
&= \frac{2}{3x^{2}}[\frac{xy^{2}}{2} + \frac{y^{3}}{3}]_{0}^{x} \\
&= \frac{2}{3x^{2}}[\frac{x^{3}}{2} + \frac{x^{3}}{3} - 0] \\
&= \frac{2}{3x^{2}} \cdot \frac{5x^{3}}{6} \\
&= \frac{1}{3x^{2}} \cdot \frac{5x^{2} \cdot x}{3} \\
&= \frac{1}{3x^{2}} \cdot \frac{5x^{2} \cdot x}{3} \\
&= \frac{5x}{9}
\end{aligned}
$$

topic_title: Maximum Likelihood Estimation
legacy_markdown:
$$
\begin{aligned}
\frac{S}{θ} + \frac{n - S}{θ - 1} &= 0 \\
(S(θ - 1) + (n - S)θ)/(θ(θ - 1)) &= 0 \\
S(θ - 1) + (n - S)θ &= 0 \\
Sθ - S + nθ - Sθ &= 0 \\
nθ - S &= 0 \\
nθ &= S \\
θ &= \frac{S}{n} \\
θ &= \frac{1}{n}∑_(i = 1)^(n)x_{i}
\end{aligned}
$$

legacy_markdown:
$$
\begin{aligned}
E[X] &= \int_{a}^{b}xf(x)dx \\
&= \int_{a}^{b}\frac{x}{b - a}dx \\
&= \frac{1}{b - a}\int_{a}^{b}xdx \\
&= \frac{1}{b - a} \cdot \left.\frac{1}{2}x^{2}\right|_{a}^{b} \\
&= (1)/(2(b - a)) \cdot (b^{2} - a^{2}) \\
&= (1)/(2(b - a)) \cdot (b - a)(b + a) \\
&= (1)/(2(b - a)) \cdot (b - a)(b + a) \\
&= \frac{a + b}{2}
\end{aligned}
$$

legacy_text: P(0 ≤ X ≤ 5, 2 ≤ Y ≤ 5)|= P(X ≤ 5, Y ≤ 5)^(⏞)^(top-right corner at [math](5,5)[/math]); = − P(X ≤ 5, Y ≤ 2)^(⏞)^(top-right corner at [math](5,2)[/math]) − P(X ≤ 0, Y ≤ 5)^(⏞)^(top-right corner at [math](0,5)[/math]); = + P(X ≤ 0, Y ≤ 2)^(⏞)^(top-right corner at [math](0,2)[/math]); = F(5, 5) − F(5, 2) − F(0, 5) + F(0, 2); = 0.9 − 0.3 − 0.45 + 0.15; = 0.3.
legacy_markdown:
$$
\begin{aligned}
P(0 \le X \le 5, 2 \le Y \le 5) &= P(X \le 5, Y \le 5)^(⏞)^(top-right corner at [math](5,5)[/math]) \\
&=-P(X \le 5, Y \le 2)^(⏞)^(top-right corner at [math](5,2)[/math]) - P(X \le 0, Y \le 5)^(⏞)^(top-right corner at [math](0,5)[/math]) \\
&= + P(X \le 0, Y \le 2)^(⏞)^(top-right corner at [math](0,2)[/math]) \\
&= F(5, 5) - F(5, 2) - F(0, 5) + F(0, 2) \\
&= 0.9 - 0.3 - 0.45 + 0.15 \\
&= 0.3
\end{aligned}
$$

topic_title: Calculating Flux in Two-Dimensional Vector Fields
legacy_markdown:
$$
\begin{aligned}
∮_(C)F \cdot nds &= ∮_(C)(P(x(t), y(t))i + Q(x(t), y(t))j) \cdot ((y^{′}(t)i - x^{′}(t)j)/(\mid \mid r^{′}(t) \mid \mid)) \mid \mid r^{′}(t) \mid \mid dt \\
&= ∮_(C)(P(x(t), y(t))i + Q(x(t), y(t))j) \cdot ((y^{′}(t)i - x^{′}(t)j)/(\mid \mid r^{′}(t) \mid \mid)) \mid \mid r^{′}(t) \mid \mid dt \\
&= ∮_(C)(P(x(t), y(t))i + Q(x(t), y(t))j) \cdot (y^{′}(t)i - x^{′}(t)j)dt \\
&= ∮_(C)P(x(t), y(t))y^{′}(t) - Q(x(t), y(t))x^{′}(t)dt \\
&= ∮_(C)Pdy - Qdx
\end{aligned}
$$

\end{aligned}

legacy_markdown:
$$
\begin{aligned}
lim_(θ → (π/2)^{+})\frac{dy}{dx} &= lim_(θ → (π/2)^{+})(y^{′}(θ))/(x^{′}(θ)) \\
&= lim_(θ → (π/2)^{+})((-\cot θ\csc θ(1 + \sin^{2} θ))/(-\cot θ(\cos θ + 2\cot θ\csc θ))) \\
&= lim_(θ → (π/2)^{+})((-\cotθ\csc θ(1 + \sin^{2} θ))/(-\cotθ(\cos θ + 2\cot θ\csc θ))) \\
&= lim_(θ → (π/2)^{+})((\csc θ(1 + \sin^{2} θ))/(\cos θ + 2\cot θ\csc θ)) \\
&= lim_(θ → (π/2)^{+})(\frac{\csc θ + \sin θ}{\cos θ + 2\cot θ\csc θ})
\end{aligned}
$$
